classification: optional MP-only reference completion using per-tet captured liner/medium material bindings for exact source166003 FP64-failed rows; not FP64 qualification, native projection, native tangent qualification, or physical validation
limits: MP roots are a separate high-precision reference result; original FP64 failure records remain unchanged.

The output arrays mix source166003 FP64-success rows with explicit MP IFT rows for FP64 failures; every paper row now uses the captured tet material index and its authored parameter offset. This is not an all-FP64 tangent assembly.
Native cached tangent comparisons are available only at the captured center state; side-state comparisons are independent CPU IFT comparisons, not native data.
No finite-difference noise-floor or assembled element/global action claim is made by finite local arrays alone.

material_binding_regression.purpose: demonstrate that the old 004 all-medium fallback binding caused the apparent s1 stress discrepancy

method.seed: accepted history plus exact captured-F elastic trial stress
method.tangent: implicit function theorem differentiated at MP root with mpmath; compared against corrected FP64 IFT at the same rounded MP root
